primary_source.title: One Reflection Is Not Enough: Self-Correcting Autonomous Research via Multi-Hypothesis Failure Attribution

matched_comparison.baseline_definition: same AutoResearchClaw host harness with MHFA and hierarchy-aware routing disabled; failed runs revert to free-form reflection
held_fixed_claimed_by_primary_source: same backbone model and model snapshot
matched_comparison.reporting_gate_boundary: The paper states the numeric reporting-integrity gate fires symmetrically on both SAGE and SAGE-w/o-MHFA arms; therefore the recovery comparison is not simply a full-arm-only numeric sanitizer advantage.
matched_comparison.principal_intervention: structured failure recovery as a bundle: divergent causal generation, independent critic/severity ranking, deterministic hierarchy-aware routing, plus the shared explicit zero-metric implementation-repair path

verified_results.baseline_recovery_behavior: free-form Refine only, at most twice, with no escalation to method/design/hypothesis levels
verified_results.SAGE_cross_level_escalation: 7 of 11 recovered topics escalate across abstraction levels as evidence accumulates
verified_results.strict_main_conference_bar: Both arms remain poor: papers cluster around 2-3/10; structured recovery does not solve scientific writing or provenance grounding.
verified_results.human_evaluation_context: On six ML topics, blind ML-PhD reviewers rank SAGE above AutoResearchClaw, but this comparison is system-level and not a pure MHFA-only causal estimate.

causal_interpretation.supported: Within this frozen 12-topic campaign, replacing monolithic free-form reflection with the structured recovery bundle materially improves experiment recovery and the rate of metrics-bearing artifacts under matched model/environment/budget conditions.
not_supported: A pure causal effect of mandatory evidence-changing scientific claim repair after a severe self-critique
An isolated effect of deterministic routing alone, independent critic alone, or divergent generation alone beyond the paper's coarse component ablations
A population-wide scientific-validity improvement or conference-quality-paper guarantee
A guarantee that method/provenance claims in prose are correct
A direct resolution of the AutoResearchEval issue-ledger closure failure pattern
causal_interpretation.why_not_exact_target_intervention: The intervention starts from failed experiments and bundles diagnosis, critic, routing and repair. It is not an arm in which the same severe epistemic critique is generated and only the post-critique policy changes from optional disclosure to mandatory rerun/claim-downgrade/hard-block.

important_failure_modes_retained_by_prim: SAGE can recover measured metrics yet still leave reporting/quality flags.
Method sections can name libraries, datasets, models, or statistical tests not used by the executed code; numeric grounding does not solve method-provenance grounding.
One SAGE arm can honestly abstain after budget exhaustion instead of fabricating a result.
Recovered artifact quality is strongly better under calibrated autonomous-research criteria but remains below strict venue-quality standards.
verification_conclusion: SAGE is a strong primary-verified matched positive control that structured multi-hypothesis diagnosis plus hierarchy-aware recovery can outperform free-form reflection under the same host pipeline, model snapshot, budgets and environment. It narrows the causal gap around failure recovery, but it does not close the more specific gap of whether a severe scientific self-critique should machine-block promotion until evidence-changing repair, material claim downgrade, or hard rejection occurs.
